audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 matches a 54.46% Shen win rate over 1770 games: Mundo owns level 1, Shen owns the taunt levels, and the lane reverts to Mundo once he is fully stacked.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted both the packet and the already-audited mirror in five of seven rows, and phases[0].why claimed Shen wins level 1 while whys[0] said the opposite.
audit.why: Mirror records the shared chart as L1 Dr. Mundo, L2 through L6 Shen, first item Skill, 2+ items Dr. Mundo. The packet also gives Mundo level 1. Shen's page had Shen winning level 1 and Mundo winning level 6, which is backwards on both counts.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Dr. Mundo at 4/10; Levels 3, 4-5 and 6 -> Shen at 6/10; First item -> Skill at 5/10. Proposed as matched full/content pairs with the ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page described W as blanking 'his auto window' without stating what passes through it, and carried no cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only. Mundo's autos and the Blunt Force Trauma reset are eaten inside the zone; Infected Bonesaw is a ranged ability and lands through it untouched. Mundo has no dash or blink, so once Shadow Dash connects he cannot leave the taunt — that is why levels 2 through 6 are Shen's.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, phases[2].why, wants.you[1] and report[5].t, with Bonesaw on a flat 4s, Heart Zapper 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s, Shadow Dash 18/16/14/12/10s and Maximum Dosage on a flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Every 'track Heart Zapper' line was abstract with no duration attached, so the reader had nothing to count.
audit.corrected: Real durations added to dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[1].why and wants.foe[1].

audit.why: missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' applies but the content already carries Grievous Wounds through early, mid, late, whys[2] and wants.you[2]. The sharper form of it — Bonesaw scaling off your current health, so raw HP stacking does not reduce it — was absent and is now in phases[0].why and wants.foe[1].
audit.corrected: Bonesaw's current-health scaling named where the reader chooses items.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Dr. Mundo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw is up every 4 seconds and scales off your current health — you have no taunt yet, so last-hit at the edge of his throw arc.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper is down.
edits.after: Shadow Dash lands and he has no dash out of the taunt — engage while Heart Zapper is down, 17s at rank 1.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Dr. Mundo must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online: Spirit's Refuge eats his autos but never Bonesaw, so taunt him onto the blade and force his Heart Zapper early.

edits.before: His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1 and heals stored damage. Fight once spent.

edits.before: Track Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper: His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Heart Zapper, 17s at rank 1, heals off stored damage. Spirit's Refuge blocks his autos, never Bonesaw.

edits.before: W-block his passive Heart Zapper regen autos to deny his sustain engine mid-trade
edits.after: Sit in Spirit's Refuge to eat his autos — Bonesaw still lands, so dodge it

edits.after: Stack Health so Bonesaw's current-HP damage grows while Maximum Dosage, 120s, outheals you

edits.before: Maximum Dosage at full items heals Mundo for an enormous chunk of his max HP; without Grievous Wounds active he simply outheal your damage in any long brawl.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage, on a flat 120s cooldown, heals a huge chunk of his missing HP; without Grievous Wounds active he outheals your damage in any long brawl.

notes: REJECTED A SUPPLIED INTERACTION, matching the mirror. missingInteractions claims 'Dr. Mundo can cancel your Stand United (R) with Goes Where He Pleases (P)'. That is false — Goes Where He Pleases is a self-applied resist to the first immobilizing effect, not an outgoing CC, and Mundo's kit contains no interrupt. Not written into any field. Packet defect 'Hit Infected Bonesaw' is a FALSE POSITIVE: Infected Bonesaw is Mundo's real Q name; no edit made.
